events.verdict: Miller (CHA) places his off-arm against White (CHI), but does not extend it into him and dislodge him from his position.
Collins (CHI) establishes screening position in Miller's (CHA) path and the two players briefly engage following the pick.
Giddey (CHI) briefly places an arm around Miller (CHA), but the contact is marginal.
Miller (CHA) initiates illegal contact with Giddey (CHI) during his shooting motion.
James (CHA) establishes a screening position in Jones' (CHI) path and the contact as Jones defends around the screen is marginal.
Collins (CHI) jumps for the rebound and the ensuing contact with Miller (CHA) is marginal.
Collins (CHI) jumps forward into James (CHA) and makes contact to his arm after the release that is more than marginal.
Giddey (CHI) swipes down and makes contact to Bridges' (CHA) arm during his shot attempt that is more than marginal.
Knueppel (CHA) moves laterally into White (CHI), affecting his SQBR.

Replay review of the foul called on Collins (CHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Collins directly contests Knueppel's (CHA) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to his hand after the release. Chicago has imminent possession at the point of interruption and therefore play resumes with Chicago's ball.
Knueppel (CHA) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Miller (CHA) commits a take foul on White (CHI).
